It turns out that the Bonesky and Emberpup families have been fighting each other for control of Beast Fang Ridge.
However, it’s not all hostile between them—some Boneskies and Emberpups are secretly friends.
It’s worth noting that Boneskies and Emberpups once coexisted peacefully and had a simple partnership—
Boneskies would create ice pillars, while Emberpups would melt them with fire to get fresh water in the caverns.
What’s more, stronger Emberpups would thaw the surface of the underground river with fire, whereas stronger Boneskies would absorb the biting cold air in the cave to prevent the Emberpups coming to fetch water from getting frostbite.
